scope_guards: The current structured capacity is retained once at 104 dwellings.
Application 22/01757/FULL and variation 25/01215/VAR are linked chronology, not two 104-home schemes.
The 2025 variation explicitly retains all 104 flats and does not create additional capacity.
Twenty-three affordable units and 22 percent affordable housing are subsets of the 104 total, not additional homes.
The delegated committee resolution and its S106 condition are not silently treated as proof of final issued variation permission.
A point with blank geometry and an ownership category cannot establish exact HMLR title topology.
No promotion or score is written until exact geometry, title relation, overlays and variation finality evidence are available.
